# Certificate Bottom Section Analysis

## 1. Student Details Layout
- **Labels and values arranged in a horizontal row** with labels on the left and values on the right
- "Name of Student" label with value "ROHTAS" (left side)
- "Mother's Name" label with value "RAJ BALA" (right side)
- Both fields have horizontal lines underneath for填写
- Clean, aligned layout with consistent spacing

## 2. Course Information Layout
- **Vertical arrangement** with labels and values in separate rows
- "Course Name" label with value "Nursery Teacher Training Course"
- "Course Duration" label with value "2 Year"
- "From" and "To" labels with dates "May 2023" and "Apr 2025"
- Each field has horizontal lines for填写
- Clear hierarchical organization

## 3. Exam Results Section
- **Percentage and grade positioned side by side**
- "He/She has Passed the Examination with" label
- "84.30%" (percentage) positioned to the right of this label
- "Grade" label with "A+" value to the far right
- All elements aligned horizontally on the same line

## 4. Signature Areas
- **Two signature areas**:
  - Left: "Sign. of Authorized Signatory" with a handwritten signature above it
  - Right: "Seal of Authorized Signatory" (no signature, just the label)
- Both positioned in the middle section of the certificate
- Symmetrically placed around the QR code

## 5. Stamp/Seal Images
- **Two official seals**:
  - Top right: Circular seal with "HARYANA INSTITUTE IT & MANAGEMENT" text and an emblem
  - Bottom center: Two additional seals:
    - Left: MSME (Micro, Small & Medium Enterprises) logo with "Ministry of MSME, Govt. of India"
    - Right: ISO 9001:2015 certification seal (blue circular badge)

## 6. QR Code Position
- **Centered horizontally** in the middle of the certificate
- Positioned between the signature areas
- Square format with black and white pattern

## 7. Footer Text and Logos
- **Bottom section contains**:
  - Website: "www.hiimedu.in" with globe icon
  - Email: "verification@hiimedu.in" with envelope icon
- Both positioned at the very bottom, centered
- Additional MSME and ISO logos in the bottom center area

## 8. Background Color/Gradient
- **Soft gradient background** transitioning from:
  - Light blue/teal at the top
  - To pale yellow/cream in the middle
  - To light pink at the bottom
- Subtle, professional appearance with a watermark pattern of "HARYANA INSTITUTE IT & MANAGEMENT" repeated diagonally
- Blue decorative border with intricate pattern around the entire certificate edge

The overall design is formal and professional, with clear organization of information and official branding elements.
